t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I was advised that it was completely random, to not focus too much on different heights and colours. I was also advised to take advantage of the breaks, to ensure good concentration.

vb_textbox.text: Hello.  I feel that for the most part it was random, however I did try and avoid blue and yellow, as they would sometimes score the lowest out of all of them.  My best advice is to adjust your choices, if you see a pattern with certain colours or heights.Try and utilize your breaks, as this will make sure you are refreshed for every round and will make sure your concentration for pressing the keys are at a maximum.Good luck.
